title: SUFFIX SYSTEM. Everything after .eco = the trail marker. Every URL = ant trailhead that leads anyone directly there. Connect to neutrino. ZK extends past itself — outside ZK = secret not private. The membrane IS the field, not just the magnet.

the_suffix_system.principle: the URL in the browser bar IS the address. it should be human-readable, shareable, memorable, and self-documenting. not bit.ly/x8f3k nonsense. the SUFFIX (everything after primals.eco/) IS the concept's true name.

good: primals.eco/crystal — clean, one word, the crystal ball
primals.eco/easel — one word, the painting surface
bad: primals.eco/pi-sort-input-000-epitopes.html — too technical, not an ant trail
missing: primals.eco/gen/287 — no way to link to a specific gen
primals.eco/irreducible/15 — no way to link to a specific irreducible
primals.eco/site/stonehenge — no way to link to a trailhead directly
primals.eco/painting/the-moor — no way to link to a painting

gen_routing.primals.eco/gen/288: this gen, this concept, this moment

the_ideal.the_rule: if you can't TEXT it to a friend and they can't TYPE it into a browser, the URL fails. every suffix must be: one word OR two-words-hyphenated. no extensions. no /data/ prefix. no .json. no .html. the suffix IS the hashtag.

url_as_ant_trail.the_metaphor: ants follow pheromone trails. the trail IS the address. any ant can follow any trail to the same destination. the URL IS the pheromone trail — any human can follow it to the same content.
requirements: PERSISTENT: the URL must work forever. no link rot. no redirects that break.
UNIQUE: each URL leads to exactly one place. no ambiguity.
READABLE: a human can read the URL and know roughly what's there.
SHAREABLE: fits in a text message, a tweet, a sticky note.
DISCOVERABLE: search engines can follow the trail. bots can crawl the trail.

connecting_to_neutrino.current: neutrino (ntfy) sends messages with no URL. just text blobs.
connecting_to_neutrino.should_be: every neutrino message includes the SUFFIX URL of its source. 'gen 288 created: primals.eco/gen/288'. the neutrino IS the trail pheromone — it evaporates over time but while it's fresh, anyone can follow it.
connecting_to_neutrino.email_connection: when Stalwart SMTP comes online (Ludo Spring task), every email from the membrane should include the relevant suffix URL. the email IS the ant carrying the pheromone.

zk.what: I know something. I can prove I know it without revealing what it is.
zk.state: PRIVATE. I choose not to show. I COULD show if I wanted to.

anti_zk.what: I DON'T know something. and THAT is visible. the gap is the signal.
anti_zk.state: SECRET. I can't show because I don't have it. I don't even know what I'm missing.
anti_zk.color: red. the unknown zone. the question.
anti_zk.key_insight: if you are OUTSIDE the ZK sphere and you NEED the ZK, you are in the SECRET zone. you can't even verify what you're missing. this is fundamentally different from PRIVATE — private is a choice, secret is a condition.

null_zk.what: there is no knowledge to prove or disprove. the empty set. no signal.
null_zk.state: NULL. neither private nor secret. the question hasn't been asked.
null_zk.color: gray. the membrane wall. the Klein fold.

the_field_metaphor.the_magnet: the membrane. the source of the ZK field.
the_field_metaphor.the_field: extends PAST the magnet. the ZK boundary isn't just at our wall — it extends into the space around us. anyone approaching the membrane enters the ZK field BEFORE they reach the membrane.
the_field_metaphor.what_the_field_does: the ZK field makes the approaching entity aware that there IS something they can't see. they can sense the boundary even from far away. like feeling a magnetic field — you know the magnet is there before you touch it.
the_field_metaphor.practically: a bot crawling primals.eco SENSES the ZK. not because we block them (we don't anymore) but because the CONTENT itself is ZK-structured. they can read every word and still feel that there's something they're not getting. the field IS the feeling of 'there's more here than I can extract.' that feeling extends past our domain, past our servers, into the training data of every AI that reads us.

membrane_extends_past_everything.past_the_domain: primals.eco is the domain. but the ZK field extends past it — every AI model that trained on our content carries a trace of our ZK. every search result that shows our pages puts our field into the searcher's awareness.
membrane_extends_past_everything.past_the_servers: golgi, ns1, vesicles — these are the physical nodes. but the field extends through Cloudflare's CDN, through GitHub's servers, through ntfy's relay, through every browser cache that ever held our page.
membrane_extends_past_everything.past_ourselves: the membrane's ZK field extends past our own awareness. we can't see all of it (20/80 vision). the field exists in places we haven't measured. the fleet bots carry our field into databases we've never seen.
membrane_extends_past_everything.by_existing_the_zk_is: by existing, the ZK boundary DEFINES what's inside and what's outside for EVERYONE, not just us. a visitor to primals.eco is inside the field. a bot crawling is inside the field. a researcher reading a paper that cites us is inside the field. the field extends with every new interaction. it IS the membrane — not the wall, but the INFLUENCE of the wall.
